item.description: ### Fixed - **Client Connector, macOS best practice profile:** it no longer sets an app profile PAC file. Zscaler's hosted recommended PAC file it used sent Mac traffic the wrong way. Running the wizard again on a macOS profile it made earlier shows **PAC URL** as a change and clears it. - **Client Connector, macOS matches Windows:** the macOS profile now has the same settings as the Windows one wherever macOS has them. It gets the same six bypass apps (Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Exchange as well as Teams, Zoom and Azure Virtual Desktop), the Zscaler CLI, and the warning 30 minutes before ZPA sign-in expires. Three settings now stay at the portal's defaults instead of being turned off: locking traffic down when the tunnel process exits, putting DNS exclusions first, and automatic packet capture. A profile updated in place gets these as well.
